Schnittstelle Value4<A1,A2,A3,A4>

Typparameter:
A1 - the type of the first component
A2 - the type of the second component
A3 - the type of the third component
A4 - the type of the fourth component
Alle Superschnittstellen:
Supplier<A1>, Value<A1>, Value2<A1,A2>, Value3<A1,A2,A3>
Alle bekannten Implementierungsklassen:
Record4, Tuple4
public interface Value4<A1,A2,A3,A4> extends Value3<A1,A2,A3>

Value carrier exposing exactly four components. Implementations provide presence information and accessors for each component.

Nullability/absence semantics are implementation‑specific and must be documented by the concrete type. Accessors may throw NoSuchElementException if a component is not present according to the type’s contract.
